break.d: Broken blocks puff out shiny soap bubbles that wobble up and pop into rings.
Little pink and red hearts float up out of every block you break, then pop.
Cherry blossoms bloom open as the block breaks and drift away with loose petals.
Sparkling snowflakes spin out of the block and fall softly.
Glowing fireflies wake up inside the block and wander off, blinking.
Colourful butterflies flutter out of every broken block.
Spinning gold coins burst out of the block and fly into your pocket.
A tiny ringed planet and its stars spiral out of the block like a small galaxy.
Crowned little ghosts rise from the block, wave about, then float over to you.
Dark phantoms with glowing eyes circle the broken block, then dash into you in a violet flash.
